topics.label: Lecture introduction
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the lecturer's opening remarks, framing complement's complexity and introducing the scope of the lecture.

topics.label: Foundational principles of the complement cascade
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics provide the overarching operational framework, nomenclature, and central biochemical role of C3 in the complement cascade.

topics.label: Pathways of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the three distinct recognition pathways that converge on activating C3 to reach the trigger threshold.

topics.label: Complement effector mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the primary effector outcomes by which activated complement eliminates pathogens and enhances immune defense.

topics.label: Regulation of complement on host cells
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the regulatory mechanisms and proteins that protect host tissues from accidental complement-mediated destruction.

topics.label: Clinical consequences of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the distinct pathological presentations and disease susceptibilities associated with deficiencies across the complement cascade.

topics.label: Microbial evasion of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the evolutionary strategies pathogens use to circumvent complement activity, focusing on Staphylococcus aureus.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the session and announces the subject of the next lecture.
